query:
insert into IgnoredReviewEntries (
                latest_collection,
                product_id,
                review_name,
                entry_hash
            )
            values (
                $1,
                $2,
                $3,
                $4
            )
            on conflict (
                product_id,
                review_name,
                entry_hash
            ) do update
            set
                latest_collection = excluded.latest_collection
